mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name, url, size, mime_type, uploader_id, create_time FROM media ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT id, file_name, url, size, mime_type, uploader_id, create_time FROM media WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (file_name, url, size, mime_type, uploader_id, create_time) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{url}, #{size}, #{mimeType}, #{uploaderId}, NOW())
